css: #battlebar .battle-btn { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:12px; border:1px solid var(--accent); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; padding:3px 10px }
#battlebar { align-items:center; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); display:none; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; padding:4px 14px }

#branchPanel .b-head { background:var(--surface-2); border-bottom:2px solid var(--border); color:var(--text-sub); font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.5px; padding:8px 12px; text-transform:uppercase }
#branchPanel .b-item .b-cur { background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:4px; border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--text); flex:none; font-size:10px; font-weight:600; padding:1px 5px }
#branchPanel .b-item .b-prev { color:var(--text); flex:none; font-size:12px; line-height:1.3; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap }

#branchPanel .b-item .b-who { align-items:center; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:5px; border:2px solid var(--border); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); color:var(--text-sub); display:flex; flex:none; font-size:14px; height:30px; justify-content:center; width:30px }

#branchPanel .b-item { align-items:flex-start; background:var(--surface); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; display:flex; font-size:12px; gap:10px; padding:9px 12px }
#branchPanel .b-item.cur { background:var(--panel); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--border-strong), inset 0 0 0 3px var(--line); position:relative }
#branchPanel .b-item.cur::after { background:var(--border-strong); bottom:0; content:""; position:absolute; right:0; top:0; width:4px }
#branchPanel .b-item.seg { background:var(--panel); color:var(--text-sub); display:block; font-size:11px; font-style:italic; padding:6px 12px }

#branchPanel { background:var(--panel); border-radius:10px; border:2px solid var(--border); box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.4), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); display:none; max-height:400px; overflow-y:auto; position:absolute; right:0; top:38px; width:340px; z-index:40 }

#choices .choice-btn { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:14px; border:1px solid var(--accent); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; font-size:13px; max-width:320px; padding:6px 12px; text-align:left; transition:background .15s, transform .1s }
#imgprev { align-items:center; color:var(--sub); display:flex; font-size:12px; gap:8px; padding:4px 14px }
#input { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); flex:1; font-family:inherit; font-size:14px; max-height:120px; padding:9px 12px; resize:none }
#inputbar .plus { background:none; border:none; color:var(--accent); cursor:pointer; font-size:22px; padding:0 4px }
#inputbar { align-items:flex-end; border-top:1px solid var(--line); display:flex; gap:6px; padding:10px 14px }
#mechbar .mb-bar { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:3px; display:inline-block; height:5px; margin-left:2px; overflow:hidden; vertical-align:middle; width:90px }
#mechbar { align-items:center; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--sub); display:none; flex-wrap:wrap; font-size:11px; gap:4px 16px; padding:3px 14px }
#quickpanel .chip { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; flex:1; font-size:11px; padding:6px 4px }
#quickpanel { animation:slideup .18s ease-out; background:var(--panel); border-top:1px solid var(--line); display:none; padding:6px 14px }
#send { background:var(--accent); border-radius:10px; border:none; color:var(--accent-text); cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; padding:9px 18px }

#sidebar { background:var(--panel); border-right:1px solid var(--line); display:flex; flex-direction:column; min-width:0; overflow:hidden; transition:width .28s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1), opacity .2s ease; width:236px }

.ach-toast .a-ic { align-items:center; background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:6px; border:2px solid var(--border); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); color:var(--text-sub); display:flex; font-size:16px; height:36px; justify-content:center; width:36px }

.ach-toast { align-items:center; background:var(--panel); border-radius:12px; border:2px solid var(--border); box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45), inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line); display:flex; gap:10px; left:50%; max-width:440px; padding:10px 16px; position:fixed; top:16px; transform:translate(-50%,-140%); transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1); z-index:9500 }
.ag-kv code { background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:4px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); font-family:Consolas,"Courier New",monospace; font-size:11px; padding:0 4px }
.ag-prov { background:var(--surface); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); display:grid; gap:2px 10px; grid-template-columns:150px 1fr; margin:6px 0; padding:8px 10px }
.ag-row { color:var(--text); display:flex; font-size:12px; gap:8px; line-height:1.7; padding:2px 0 }
.avatar { background:var(--line); border-radius:50%; flex:none; height:28px; object-fit:cover; width:28px }
.avatar.letter { align-items:center; color:var(--text); display:flex; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; justify-content:center }
.aw-card { background:var(--surface); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; line-height:1.5; padding:8px 10px; text-align:left }
.aw-key { background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); font-family:Consolas,"Courier New",monospace; font-size:13px; padding:8px 10px; width:100% }
.aw-pill { background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text-sub); flex:1; font-size:11px; padding:4px 6px; text-align:center }

.btn { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; display:block; font-size:13px; margin:5px 12px; padding:7px 10px; text-align:left; width:calc(100% - 24px) }
.bubble { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:var(--radius); font-size:14px; line-height:1.55; padding:9px 13px; white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word }
.cards-head { align-items:center; cursor:pointer; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:8px 12px; user-select:none }
.chip2 { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; padding:5px 10px }
.dd-caret { background:none; border:none; color:var(--sub); cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; position:absolute; right:6px; top:6px }
.dd-item { border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); cursor:pointer; font-size:13px; padding:8px 12px }
.dd-overlay .o-item { border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); cursor:pointer; display:flex; font-size:13px; gap:8px; justify-content:space-between; padding:9px 12px }

.dd-overlay { background:var(--panel); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5); max-height:280px; min-width:260px; overflow-y:auto; position:fixed; z-index:999 }

.dd-panel { background:var(--panel); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45); left:0; max-height:230px; overflow-y:auto; position:absolute; right:0; top:100%; z-index:80 }
.dd-select { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; font-size:13px; padding:8px 10px; width:100% }

.gal-chip { align-items:center; background:var(--bubble); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); cursor:grab; display:inline-flex; font-size:12px; gap:6px; margin:0; min-width:60px; padding:7px 10px; white-space:nowrap }
.gal-chip.choice { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--warn) 14%, var(--bubble)); border-color:var(--warn); color:var(--warn) }
.gal-editor input,.gal-editor select,.gal-editor textarea { background:var(--panel); border-radius:6px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); font-size:12px; padding:5px 8px }
.gal-editor { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); margin:6px 0; padding:10px 12px }

.gal-insert { align-self:center; background:var(--bubble); border-radius:50%; border:1px dashed var(--line); color:var(--sub); cursor:pointer; flex:none; font-size:12px; height:22px; line-height:20px; margin:0 2px; text-align:center; width:22px }
.gal-line { background:var(--panel); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); margin:10px 0 }
.gal-line-head { align-items:center; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line); cursor:pointer; display:flex; gap:8px; padding:8px 12px }
.gal-top .gal-actions { align-items:center; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px 12px; justify-content:flex-end; margin-left:auto; min-width:0 }
.gal-top { align-items:center; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px 12px; padding:14px 18px }
.ic { align-items:center; display:inline-flex; height:1.25em; justify-content:center; margin-right:2px; vertical-align:-0.2em; width:1.25em }

.mech-fold .fold-head { align-items:center; border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; display:flex; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; justify-content:space-between; padding:4px 0; user-select:none }
.modal { align-items:center; background:rgba(0,0,0,.55); display:none; inset:0; justify-content:center; position:fixed; z-index:50 }
.modal-box .btn2 { background:var(--accent); border-radius:8px; border:none; color:var(--accent-text); cursor:pointer; padding:7px 16px }

.modal-box input,.modal-box textarea,.modal-box select { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); font-family:inherit; font-size:13px; padding:8px 10px; width:100% }

.modal-box { animation:pop .2s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1); background:var(--panel); border-radius:14px; border:1px solid var(--line); max-height:84vh; max-width:92vw; overflow-y:auto; padding:18px 20px; width:420px }

.ms { -webkit-font-feature-settings:'liga'; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; direction:ltr; display:inline-block; font-family:'Material Symbols Outlined'; font-feature-settings:'liga'; font-size:1.15em; font-style:normal; font-weight:normal; letter-spacing:normal; line-height:1; text-transform:none; vertical-align:-0.16em; white-space:nowrap; word-wrap:normal }
.msg .av { background:var(--line); border-radius:50%; flex:none; height:34px; object-fit:cover; width:34px }
.msg .mctl button { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:7px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--sub); cursor:pointer; font-size:11px; padding:2px 8px }
.msg .mctl { align-items:center; color:var(--sub); display:none; font-size:11px; gap:4px; margin-top:4px }
.msg.sys .bubble { background:var(--surface-2); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text-sub); font-size:12px }

.onb-box { background:var(--panel); border-radius:16px; border:1px solid var(--line); box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6); left:50%; max-width:92vw; padding:22px 24px; position:absolute; top:46%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); width:430px }
.p-grid input { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); font-size:12px; padding:6px 8px; width:100% }

.prow .pset input[type=text],.prow .pset input[type=number],.prow .pset select { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:6px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); font-size:11px; padding:3px 6px; width:150px }
.prow { background:var(--bg); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); margin:6px 0; padding:8px 10px }
.role-card .rc-actions .iconbtn { background:none; border-radius:6px; border:none; color:var(--sub); cursor:pointer; flex:0 0 auto; font-size:12px; opacity:.7; padding:4px 8px; white-space:nowrap }
.role-card .rc-actions { align-items:center; border-top:1px dashed var(--line); display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; padding-top:8px; row-gap:6px }
.role-card .rc-name .avatar.letter { align-items:center; color:var(--text); display:flex; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; justify-content:center }
.role-card .rc-name label { align-items:center; color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; display:flex; flex:1; font-size:14px; font-weight:600; gap:8px; overflow:hidden }
.role-card { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); display:block; margin:8px 12px; padding:8px 10px }
.role-row label { align-items:center; cursor:pointer; display:flex; flex:1; font-size:13px; gap:8px; overflow:hidden }
.save-new input { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); font-size:13px; padding:7px 10px }
.save-row .save-label { color:var(--text); display:block; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap }
.save-row .save-ops .iconbtn { background:none; border-radius:6px; border:none; color:var(--sub); cursor:pointer; font-size:13px; opacity:.7; padding:3px 6px }
.save-row { align-items:center; background:var(--bubble); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); display:flex; gap:8px; margin:6px 0; padding:8px 10px }
.sg-bubble .sg-arrow { border:9px solid transparent; height:0; position:absolute; width:0 }
.sg-bubble .sg-btns button { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; padding:5px 12px }

.sg-bubble { background:var(--panel); border-radius:12px; border:1px solid var(--accent); box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5); color:var(--text); font-size:13px; line-height:1.55; max-width:300px; padding:12px 14px; position:fixed; z-index:9002 }

.sg-highlight { border-radius:10px; border:3px solid var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 0 2000px rgba(6,7,16,.72), 0 0 26px rgba(201,162,39,.6); pointer-events:none; position:fixed; transition:all .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1); z-index:9001 }
.side-head button { background:none; border:none; color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; font-size:18px; padding:2px 6px }
.topbar button { background:none; border:none; color:var(--text); cursor:pointer; font-size:18px }
.topbar { align-items:center; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); display:flex; gap:8px; padding:10px 14px }
.wentry .we-dot { background:var(--line); border-radius:50%; display:inline-block; flex:none; height:9px; width:9px }
.wentry textarea { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); font-family:inherit; font-size:13px; padding:7px 9px; resize:vertical; width:100% }
.wentry { background:var(--bg); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); margin:8px 0; padding:8px 10px }
.ws-card { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:10px; border:1px solid var(--line); padding:8px 10px }
.ws-cards { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; max-height:300px; overflow:auto; padding:2px }
.ws-col select { background:var(--bubble); border-radius:8px; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); font-size:12px; padding:6px; width:100% }
@font-face { font-display:block; font-family:'Material Symbols Outlined'; font-style:normal; font-weight:300; src:url('../fonts/MaterialSymbolsOutlined.woff2') format('woff2') }
@keyframes pop { from{ transform:scale(.97); opacity:0; opacity:1; }; } to{ transform:scale(1) }
@keyframes slideup { from{ transform:translateY(8px); opacity:0; opacity:1; }; } to{ transform:translateY(0) }
body { background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); font-family:"Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei",sans-serif; overflow:hidden }
